//==
// # Images — derived functions for IImage
//
// Bodies for the `IImage` interface declared in `images.concepts.plato`: a raster with
// known whole-pixel dimensions. The helpers derive the pixel count, the aspect
// and orientation tests, coordinate validity, and the row-major flat index that
// matches the tree's top-left-first storage convention. Pure expressions only;
// all inputs are immutable and evaluation is side-effect free. See
// `CONVENTIONS.md` for the UV-origin and image-storage convention.

library Images
{
    //==
    // # IImage
    //
    // A raster with known dimensions: Size is the one obligation, and every
    // raster stores it, so the whole-pixel Width and Height are projections of it.

    // The width of the image in whole pixels.
    Width(self: IImage): Integer
        => self.Size.Width;
